NBA DFS Rankings for Thursday, October 22 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Thursday, October 22 · 2 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 22, 10:32 AM ET

Nikola Jokic (DEN) ranks first on the Thursday, October 22 DraftKings main slate at 60.2 projected DraftKings points for $10,900. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 51.4) and Joel Embiid (PHI, 42.3) are next.

The table ranks all 27 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 22, 10:32 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
